1 📜 Hostel Rules & Regulations

By registering your pet at Happy Paws & Pixels, you agree to comply with the following hostel rules:

  • All pets must be fully vaccinated and in good health upon arrival.
  • Pets showing signs of illness, parasites, or contagious conditions will not be admitted.
  • Check-in and check-out must be within the agreed times.
  • Late pick-up beyond [X hours] without prior notification may result in additional charges.
  • The hostel reserves the right to refuse admission to any pet deemed unsuitable for communal accommodation.
  • Owners must provide accurate and complete information during registration.
  • Personal pet belongings (toys, beds, food bowls) must be clearly labelled.
  • The hostel is not responsible for the loss or damage of personal belongings.
  • All pets must be treated humanely and with respect by all staff and volunteers.
  • Any breach of rules may result in early termination of the pet's stay at the owner's expense.

⚠️ Replace bracketed text and edit these rules to reflect your actual hostel policies.

2 🐾 Pet Care Guidelines

The hostel will provide the following standard care during your pet's stay:

  • Regular scheduled feeding based on the owner's provided diet plan or our standard menu.
  • Fresh, clean drinking water available at all times.
  • Daily exercise and supervised playtime appropriate for the pet's breed and health.
  • Daily observation for signs of discomfort, illness, or abnormal behaviour.
  • Basic grooming and hygiene maintenance including brushing and bathing if required.
  • Administration of medication as directed by the owner (provided with clear instructions and labelling).
  • Separate accommodation for dogs and cats to minimize stress.
  • Enrichment activities appropriate to species and individual temperament.
ℹ️ Owners with pets requiring special care must notify the hostel prior to check-in. Additional charges may apply for specialized care services.

3 👤 Owner Responsibilities

As the owner or authorized guardian of the pet, I acknowledge and accept the following responsibilities:

  • I confirm that my pet is healthy, vaccinated, and free from contagious diseases.
  • I have provided accurate information regarding my pet's health, diet, behaviour, and medical history.
  • I will ensure my pet is picked up on or before the agreed check-out date and time.
  • I am financially responsible for any veterinary expenses incurred during my pet's stay due to illness, injury, or emergency.
  • I agree to be contactable during my pet's stay and will respond to communications promptly.
  • I have provided an accurate and reachable emergency contact.
  • I understand that the hostel is not liable for pre-existing medical conditions that may deteriorate during the stay.
  • I consent to the hostel taking photographs/videos of my pet for welfare monitoring and, with permission, for promotional use.

4 📝 Terms & Conditions

Payment & Cancellation:

  • Payment must be made upon check-in or as per the agreed payment schedule.
  • Cancellations made more than [48 hours] before check-in: Full refund.
  • Cancellations within [48 hours] of check-in: [50%] charge may apply.
  • No-shows will be charged the full stay amount.

Liability:

  • The hostel maintains all reasonable standards of care, but cannot guarantee complete prevention of illness or injury.
  • The hostel is not liable for loss of or damage to personal pet belongings.
  • The hostel reserves the right to make decisions in the pet's best interest if the owner is unreachable.

Data Privacy:

  • Personal information collected is used solely for hostel management purposes.
  • Data is stored securely and not shared with third parties without consent.
  • Owner and pet records may be retained for up to [2 years] after the last stay.

⚠️ Replace bracketed terms with your actual hostel's policies and consult legal guidance if necessary.

5 🆘 Emergency Contact Requirements & Procedures

⚠️ An accurate emergency contact is mandatory. Failure to provide one may affect your pet's ability to receive timely care.
  • The owner must provide a valid emergency contact who can be reached 24/7.
  • The emergency contact must be someone with authority to make decisions on behalf of the pet if the owner is unreachable.
  • In a medical emergency, the hostel staff will attempt to contact the owner first, then the emergency contact.
  • If neither party is reachable within [30 minutes], the hostel may take the pet to a veterinary clinic for assessment.
  • All emergency veterinary costs are the owner's responsibility.
  • The hostel will document and report all incidents to the owner at the earliest opportunity.
